audit.whatIsWrong: Text called levels 1-5 Renekton's with vague reasons ('fury dashes', 'long Q cooldown'). Mundo's Q is a 4s cooldown, not long; the real early cost is that Infected Bonesaw is paid in health while Cull the Meek heals Renekton back.
audit.why: Kit file: Mundo Q cd 4, cost is health; Renekton Q flagged heal. Difficulty is early-only and it is a Fury problem, not a cooldown problem.
audit.corrected: Levels 1-5 Renekton, skill from 4-5, Mundo from 6 — driven by Fury state, not by Mundo's cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4] said Renekton 'keeps lane edge' at 6 while win[4] and phases[4] both award level 6 to Dr. Mundo — a direct self-contradiction on the champion's biggest spike.
audit.why: Maximum Dosage instantly heals a percent of missing health plus regen and move speed; that is the flip point, and the chart already says so.
audit.corrected: Level 6 belongs to Mundo; the why now states the R mechanic that causes it.

audit.whatIsWrong: None of Renekton's abilities were named in content prose, the 50-Fury threshold was never stated, Ruthless Predator's shield-destruction and 1.5s empowered stun were absent, and Grievous Wounds against Cull the Meek was never mentioned.
audit.why: Riot text: empowered W slashes three times, destroys damage shields, stuns 1.5s (0.75s unempowered); Q heals a portion of damage dealt and is increased above 50 Fury; E dash 16/14.5/13/11.5/10. Mundo passive resists the first immobilizing effect and drops a canister — that is the answer to the stun.
audit.corrected: Prose now names Ruthless Predator, Cull the Meek, Slice and Dice, states the 50-Fury threshold, the 1.5s stun, the 13s E at rank 3, the passive canister pickup, and Grievous Wounds timing.

audit.why: Mundo's passive canister is the reason the empowered stun is survivable; it is now stated in tradeGood.

edits.before: Renekton bullies level 1 with superior base stats and dash pressure while your regen is minimal.
edits.after: Renekton bullies level 1 with better base stats and Cull the Meek's heal while your regen is thin.

edits.before: At 2 he can already Slice-Dice reset and out-trade your long Q cooldown.
edits.after: At 2 he has Slice and Dice in-and-out, and each Bonesaw costs you health.

edits.before: Level 3 gives him W stun plus a dash, the peak of his kill pressure on you.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator empowered stuns 1.5s into Slice and Dice — his peak kill window.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 he snowballs empowered combos while your sustain is still too weak to answer.
edits.after: Slice and Dice is 13s at rank 3: step up when both charges are spent, hide while he holds them.

edits.before: Even at his level 6, his fury all-in still threatens you before your R value fully compounds — he keeps lane edge.
edits.after: Maximum Dosage (R) heals a percent of missing HP mid-combo, so his empowered W-Q burst no longer closes the kill.

edits.before: Renekton's window: at 2-3 fury Dashes he doubles his W stun and empowered Q heal, and he'll bully you off the wave with Slice-Dice-W-Q combos while your Q Infected Bonesaw is on a long cooldown and your regen is still weak.
edits.after: Renekton's window: past 50 Fury his Ruthless Predator (W) stuns 1.5s and Cull the Meek (Q) heals double, so Slice and Dice in, W, Q takes a third of your bar while your regen is thin and Bonesaw costs health.

edits.before: Renekton owns levels 1-5. His fury dashes, W stun, and empowered Q heal let him win every short trade while your Q Infected Bonesaw is on a punishing cooldown and Mundo's early regen is thin. Don't try to trade back — soak XP, cheese-recall, and give ground rather than eating a Slice-Dice-W-Q. Respect his all-in when he holds two dashes.
edits.after: Renekton owns levels 1-5. Ruthless Predator (W) stuns 1.5s at 50+ Fury and Cull the Meek (Q) heals him back, so every short trade is his — Infected Bonesaw costs you health he refunds himself. Soak XP, cheese-recall, give ground rather than eat Slice and Dice into empowered W. Respect the all-in while he holds both dash charges.

edits.before: The lane inverts at 6. R Maximum Dosage's regen and move speed neuter Renekton's combo — he blows W stun and empowered Q and simply can't kill you through it. Now you walk him down, Q him as he dashes out, and start perma-shoving so his short range and cooldowns give him nothing.
edits.after: The lane inverts at 6. Maximum Dosage (R) heals a percent of missing HP instantly, so Ruthless Predator's 1.5s stun into empowered Cull the Meek no longer closes. Bait it, walk him down, and Bonesaw him as he Slice and Dices out — his E is 13s at rank 3, yours is a 4s slow.

edits.before: Line up your trajectory cleanly past enemy minion models. Launch an Infected Bonesaw (Q) to slow and chunk their current health, then step forward only when they are slowed to execute a quick auto-attack into an enhanced Blunt Force (E) reset. If they retaliate with heavy crowd control, your passive will pop a canister backward—walk over it immediately to heal up and walk away clean. • • Dr. Mundo Top Lane Matchup Database 34
edits.after: Line your Infected Bonesaw (Q) up past the minion models — it stops on the first target hit. The slow buys you a step forward for an auto into Blunt Force (E), which resets your attack. If he answers with Ruthless Predator, your passive eats the first stun and drops a canister behind you: walk over it for the heal and leave. Buy Grievous Wounds by your second item or Cull the Meek refunds the whole trade.

edits.before: That spell is what punishes you — only step up once it’s down or baited.
edits.after: Ruthless Predator is 12s at rank 3 — step up only once it is down or baited.

edits.before: Trade where your kit beats his, then disengage before it becomes a long fight.
edits.after: Bonesaw poke plus a Blunt Force (E) reset, then step out before his Fury refills.

edits.before: Fighting on his terms lets him stack his strengths and flip the trade.
edits.after: At 50+ Fury his W stuns 1.5s and shreds shields — trade only on empty Fury.
